chunks: He will roast in a Fire of blazing flame.

key_terms.ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ: Possessing a blaze / of intense heat

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Fire of blazing flame' signify in the context of divine punishment?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the eternal torment of Abu Lahab, whose name literally means 'Father of Flame,' creating a poetic irony with his abode of fire. In Shia exegesis, this specific punishment is often linked to his obstinate rejection of the Prophet Muhammad and his active role in opposing the early Muslim community, serving as a paradigm of divine retribution for persistent arrogance.
